title: Binance Launches Private Portfolios for Spot Copy Trading
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance is pleased to announce the launch of  Private Portfolios for Spot Copy Trading , which is available on both the Binance website and Binance App. Lead Traders in eligible regions may now create Private Portfolios and share them with select Copy Traders with a unique link and code. This allows Lead Traders greater control over who engages with their Copy Trading portfolios.  How Binance Copy Trading Works: Copy Traders can select Lead Traders that they would like to copy, allowing them to learn various strategies and benefit from the trading expertise of more experienced traders.  There are two types of Copy Trading modes: Fixed Amount and Fixed Ratio. These options provide users with the flexibility to determine how they would like their trades to be executed.  Copy Traders can review performance metrics (e.g., ROI, PnL) of each Lead Trader’s portfolio before copying Lead Traders’ strategies that match their risk tolerance profile. Lead Traders also benefit as they would earn a profit share from their Copy Traders, commissions from their Copy Traders’ trading fees, and receive exclusive benefits. How to Open a Private Portfolio with Spot Copy Trading: Step 1:  Log in to your Binance account and click on [Trade] > [Copy Trading]. Step 2:  Choose [Spot Copy Trading] > [Lead] > [Spot – Private]. Step 3:  Enter the amount you’ll commit to the private portfolio as well as the profit sharing %. Step 4:  Click [Confirm].  Step 5:  Select [Create] and enter the max number of people who can join the private portfolio.  Step 6:  Generate your unique invitation link and code to enable other users to join. How to Start Copy Trading: Step 1:  Log in to your Binance account and click on [Trade] > [Copy Trading]. Step 2:  Choose [Spot Copy Trading]. Step 3:  Select a preferred portfolio and click the [Copy] button to start.
